commitMessage: chore(gate26): add FULL LFS transport rule

cohortSelfExclusion.reason: The consumption record cannot hash its own final bytes; its identity is bound by the authority and manifest instead.

cohort.reason: Publication-transport only: append exactly the single line "data/jarvise/predictive-ensemble/GATE26/V1/FULL/** filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text" immediately after the existing "data/jarvise/predictive-ensemble/** -text" line, so future GATE26 FULL products are transported through Git LFS. No other .gitattributes byte changes. Grants no permission to generate any data/jarvise/predictive-ensemble/GATE26/V1/FULL/** product byte.
